# MindMesh

> The Cognitive Layer for modern work. MindMesh is a privacy-first desktop AI assistant that connects your apps, ranks what needs attention, and helps you act with approval.

MindMesh reads Gmail, Google Calendar, Outlook Email, Outlook Calendar, SMTP, Slack, and Jira as sources without replacing them. Indexed work context stays on the device by default (local-first). Supported Gmail and Google Calendar connections are read-only. Actions require user approval. MindMesh is designed to help you work with your data, not train on it. Use the pages below as the canonical sources for product, security, and legal claims.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://mindmesh.global): Product overview. Connect apps, see what needs attention, act with approval.
- [Connected Apps](https://mindmesh.global/connected-apps): How MindMesh connects Gmail, Calendar, Outlook, SMTP, Slack, and Jira as sources.
- [Inbox](https://mindmesh.global/inbox): One inbox across connected email accounts, with filters and plain-English search.
- [Yesterday's Narrative](https://mindmesh.global/yesterdays-narrative): Structured recap of the prior day so you start with context, not clutter.
- [Upcoming Events](https://mindmesh.global/upcoming-events): Clear view of upcoming meetings and commitments so you can prepare, not scramble.
- [Sensor](https://mindmesh.global/sensor): Universal command bar for instant actions and jumps without leaving your flow.
- [Mascot](https://mindmesh.global/mascot): Conversational companion on MindMesh memory. Ask what changed, what matters, or what is next.

## How it works

- [Connect](https://mindmesh.global/#connect): Link the tools you already use so MindMesh can read them as sources.
- [Focus](https://mindmesh.global/#focus): Rank attention so the most important item is clear, with a plain-English reason.
- [Execute](https://mindmesh.global/#execute): Draft replies, block time, and complete tasks in context, with approval.
- [Features](https://mindmesh.global/#features): Inbox, narrative, events, Sensor, and Mascot as one desktop workspace.
- [Join waitlist](https://mindmesh.global/#cta): Early access for professionals who want a focused, private work layer.

## Security and Trust

- [Security](https://mindmesh.global/security): Local-first architecture, read-only integrations where it matters, and encrypted sensitive paths.
- [Trust](https://mindmesh.global/trust): Verifiable trust for professionals who want AI orchestration without giving up data control.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mindmesh.global/privacy): How MindMesh collects, uses, protects, and stores information, including third-party boundaries.
- [Sub-processors](https://mindmesh.global/sub-processors): Vendors that process customer data on MindMesh's behalf.
